# Create a copy of the array to avoid modifying the original
    result = array.copy()
    
    # Handle empty array or single element
    if len(array) <= 1:
        return result
    
    # Calculate the sum of first and last elements
    first_last_sum = array[0] + array[-1]
    
    # Sort based on whether the sum is odd or even
    if first_last_sum % 2 == 1:  # odd sum -> ascending order
        result.sort()
    else:  # even sum -> descending order
        result.sort(reverse=True)
